COLD_12ms_tail.why_12ms_is_safer_than_the_old_10ms: The archived 10 ms attempt emitted "Internal simulation error." after only ~2 min while trying to SAVE 10e6 points (~1.3 GB); the 9 ms tail run integrated 9e6 points in 10.8 min while saving only 0.5e6.
